disclaimer: Simplified estimate: 10% flat individual income tax after the standard deduction (14 MRP/month, annualized using MRP 2024 = 3,692 KZT). Mandatory pension (10%) and social/medical contributions are not included — add them manually as deductions.

regimes.label: Flat Income Tax (10%)
regimes.notes: Standard deduction of 14 MRP per month (annualized: 14 × 3,692 × 12 ≈ 620,256 KZT for 2024). Mandatory pension (10% of gross) applies separately and is excluded here.
